sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Institution"."Type" AS g, SUM("Institution"."Enrollment") AS m1 FROM "Institution"  GROUP BY "Institution"."Type"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m2" > "s4"."v"
why: total of number of enrolled students per Institution.Type (additive)
share of the all total of total of number of enrolled students (all level)
gap to the all average of total of number of enrolled students: share of the all total (all level)
